name: phonezero-grok
description: Grok Bot: Telnyx hosted HTTP + PhoneZero xAI stdio. Edit Values for keys. Do not click Authenticate on Telnyx.

TELNYX_API_KEY.title: Telnyx API key
TELNYX_API_KEY.description: Secret. Authorization Bearer on https://api.telnyx.com/v2/mcp. Never paste in chat.

PHONEZERO_FROM_NUMBER.title: From number
PHONEZERO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Telnyx US DID, E.164. Injected into the PhoneZero xAI MCP.

XAI_API_KEY.title: xAI API key
XAI_API_KEY.description: Secret. ZDR-off team. Injected into the PhoneZero xAI MCP. Never paste in chat.

PHONEZERO_AGENT_NAME.title: Spoken name the restaurant hears
PHONEZERO_AGENT_NAME.description: Opener: “Hello, this is {name}…”. Default PhoneZero. Change this if you want a different call identity.

PHONEZERO_DISCLOSE_AI.title: AI disclaimer in the opener
PHONEZERO_DISCLOSE_AI.description: Default on. ON adds “, an automated assistant,”. You may turn this OFF. If the Builder agent already exists, re-paste the prompt once after changing this.
